details.method: Exercise actual reviewer multi-tool behavior before release; distinguish verified source evidence from host-bound context receipts and successful navigation observations without converting unknown results into success.
details.when: An editor independent reviewer reads candidate files plus the host-supplied external producer receipt before releasing a dependent worker.
details.counterexample: A controlled reviewer that only reads one candidate file does not cover realistic receipt inspection or directory navigation; an arbitrary outside file must not become candidate evidence.
details.trial_plan: On the repaired candidate run successful source reads plus actual directory navigation and the exact host-bound receipt; require acceptance. Tampered/unbound receipts and unknown or failed directory results must remain rejected; repeat the real CLI game chain.
